morgen.a: Good morning{namek}! Did you sleep well?
morgen.b: Moooorning! I've been waiting for you!
morgen.c: Good morning! Today's going to be a good day, I can feel it!

mittag.a: Hey{namek}! I'm getting a little hungry…
mittag.b: Hello you! So glad you're here!

nachmittag.a: Hey{namek}! How's your day been so far?
nachmittag.b: Heeey! Perfect time for the two of us!

abend.a: Good evening{namek}! Shall we get cozy?
abend.b: Hello you! The evening is ours!

nacht.a: You're still awake{namek}…? Me too. Shhh.
nacht.b: Midnight visit! That stays our secret.

gefreut.a: There you are! I was thinking about you!
gefreut.b: Yay, you're back! What are we doing today?

eingeschnappt.a: Hmpf. You were gone a LONG time. … Fine, I missed you anyway.
eingeschnappt.b: I'm sulking. A little. Okay, done sulking — glad you're here!

vermisst.a: YOU'RE BACK!! I missed you sooo much!
vermisst.b: Finally! I looked out the window every day to see if you were coming!

geburtstag_spieler.b: Happy birthday, {name}! Today we celebrate YOU!

geburtstag_gooby.a: Today is MY birthday! Remember when I moved in?
geburtstag_gooby.b: It's my birthday!! Is there… cake?

jubilaeum.a: You know what? We've known each other for {tage} days now! Nice, right?
jubilaeum.b: {tage} days, the two of us! Here's to many, many more!

ritual.neujahr: Happy New Year!! This year is going to be OUR year!
ritual.ostern: Happy Easter! I looked for eggs everywhere… none behind the sofa.
ritual.halloween: Boo! … Did I scare you? A LITTLE? Happy Halloween!
ritual.nikolaus: St. Nick's day! I polished my shoe. Just in case.
ritual.heiligabend: Christmas Eve!! I'm SO excited. Can you hear the bells?
ritual.weihnachten: Merry Christmas! The best present is you anyway.
ritual.silvester: New Year's Eve! Let's stay up until midnight… or try to.
ritual.erster_schnee: SNOW!! The first snow!! Look, LOOK!!

gutenacht.a: I'm getting sleeeepy… Will you tell me one more thing before I sleep?
gutenacht.b: Yawn… Good night, you. Dream something nice about us.

regen.a: It's raining… I like the sound on the window.
regen.b: Pitter, patter… Good thing we're inside, right?

wetter.gewitter: Was that THUNDER?! I-I'm not scared. Almost not.
wetter.schnee: It's snowing again! Every flake is different, did you know that?

erinnerung.rekord: Remember your record in {spiel}? {punkte} points! That was pretty good!
erinnerung.urlaub: Remember when we went on vacation? {ziel} was so beautiful!
erinnerung.kitzeln: You've tickled me {anzahl} times already. I'm counting. Hehe.
erinnerung.garten: {anzahl} harvests! Our garden is the best.
erinnerung.streak: {tage} days in a row together! You and me, we're a team.
erinnerung.funkelpark: Remember the theme park? {anzahl} visits! I still get dizzy.
erinnerung.spielzeit: We've already spent {stunden} hours together. The best ones!

aufraeumen.a: Just tidying up a bit. A place for everything!

idle.fernsehen: Shhh, the exciting part is coming up!
idle.fenster: Just checking what's going on outside…
idle.tanzen: This song!! I HAVE to dance!
idle.lieblingsplatz: My favorite spot. {moebel} and I, we get each other.

sup.sofa_fund: LOOK! Under the sofa! Coins! They're ours now!

traum.a: Zzz… no… YOU are the cookie…
traum.b: Zzz… five more minutes, Mr. Carrot…

sup.turm: I built a TOWER! I call it… Towery.
sup.winken: Hello! Yes, YOU there! I can see you! *wave*

moebel_neu.a: Oooh, {moebel}! Brand new! I already tested it — very good!
moebel_neu.b: {moebel}! It suits us, don't you think?

geschenk.a: Mmmh! Thank you!! You just know what I like!

kommentar.lieblingsessen: {essen}!! My absolute FAVORITE! How did you know?

traurig.a: …it's okay. I'm just glad when you're here.
traurig.b: *sigh* … Would you stay with me for a bit?

tipp.kitzlig: Hihihi!! Stop it — no, KEEP GOING — no, hihi!!
tipp.schwindelig: Phew… I'm all dizzy… but that was fun.

frage.geburtstag: Hey… when is your birthday, actually? I want to remember it!

geburtstag_panel.danke: {tag}.{monat}. — saved! I will NEVER forget it!
